overview: This 509-page file documents postwar efforts to resolve defaulted Japanese government, municipal, and utility bonds held abroad. Bondholder inquiries and State Department replies sit alongside financial schedules, translated wartime laws, and reports on yen conversions, unpaid interest, canceled mortgages, reparations, claims, and possible peace-treaty treatment.
interest: Detailed bond records reveal how wartime financial restructuring affected foreign creditors and shaped postwar claims and diplomacy.
